cohort: The study included 1109 term male newborn infants whose mothers intended to exclusively breastfeed, of whom 846 (76.6%) were circumcised.
finding: Circumcision status or timing did not significantly affect the rate of in-hospital formula supplementation, exclusive breastfeeding, peak bilirubin levels, phototherapy requirement, or length of hospital stay in this cohort of breastfed male newborns.
